matrix_note: Pinned 0.4.39 source b13ddd632bde1fea7678386c345665ea5fa671af: hermesllm/src/clients/endpoints.rs accepts Chat, Responses and Messages ingress, with no Gemini, Cohere or Bedrock client API. providers/id.rs::compatible_api_for_client selects native Responses only for Responses ingress to OpenAI, Chat for Messages-to-OpenAI, native Messages for Messages-to-Anthropic, and Converse for all three ingress APIs to amazon_bedrock. Anthropic Chat/Responses ingress and Gemini provider use OpenAI-compatible upstream wire; they are not native Anthropic/Gemini translations. The normal provider mapping is retained rather than substituting a different provider for the OpenAI column. Seven supported pairs are enabled, including the documented Bedrock upstream.
